title: Will You Marry Me?
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kairi Sasaki, an omega and a new employee at a marriage counseling company, is assigned to find a wife for Haruomi Jinguuji, a wealthy alpha client who keeps making advances at him instead (Manga Club blurb via AniList). It is a one-volume adult boys' love romance in the omegaverse setting; MangaUpdates tags add a past one-night stand, a secret child, single fatherhood and a marriage proposal.
life_message: It holds up honest love, commitment and shared parenting as the answer to past mistakes and miscommunication.
